leaves.name: kleimanPicZeroProperQ
leaves.doc: kleiman-section: for `X` proper and geometrically normal over a field `K`, the identity component of any scheme representing Kleiman's `Pic_{(X/K)(fppf)}` (the fppf sheafification of `T ↦ Pic(X_T)/Pic(T)`, Def. 9.2.2) is proper (Kleiman, *The Picard scheme*, Thm 9.5.4; locator UNVERIFIED). `picardFunctorIsoKleiman` (proved, no section) identifies Kleiman's sheaf with the tree's `picardFunctor`.
leaves.flag: unread: Kleiman 9.5.4 over Kleiman's quotient functor T ↦ Pic(X_T)/Pic(T) (comparison with picardFunctor proved, no section); reading risks proper vs projective and étale vs fppf (the hand fold's KleimanPicZeroProperPrinted avoids both); locator UNVERIFIED
